title: The Traveling Players
text: A troupe of players on the otherworld road, painted and grinning, are putting on a play about your Houses on the back of their wagon. They have most of the details wrong. The few they have right, no one outside your Houses should know.

options.label: Watch the play to learn what the world thinks of you.

outcomes.text: It is a good play. You laugh, and learn something about how others see you.

options.label: The best talker corrects them so the story is told your way.

outcomes.text: They rewrite it on the spot. Word will spread your way.

options.label: The richest House pays them to make a rival the villain.

outcomes.text: They gladly take the coin and the note. Sooner or later, the rival will see the play.
